# ChunkFlow runtime implementation in this fork

The paper's "ChunkFlow" is implemented as a **comm-aware chunk-wise variant of SGLang's layerwise DiT offload**, living entirely under `python/sglang/multimodal_gen/`. There is **no custom CUDA kernel** involved: the recent commits "add comm-window-mode kernel" (7468b8b1b), "update comm-window-mode kernel end marker" (5a6e73af3), and "monitor work complete marker" (94da08ee2) refer to the comm-activity-window **mode named `"kernel"`** (`--dit-comm-active-window-mode kernel|launch`), i.e. tracking a collective's *GPU-kernel-level* completion instead of its host-side launch. Nothing in `sgl-kernel/` or `python/sglang/jit_kernel/` is part of this feature (`jit_kernel/cuda_wait_value.py` is upstream SGLang, unused here).

## 1. Where layerwise offloading lives; the "Layerwise" baseline

- Dispatcher: `python/sglang/multimodal_gen/runtime/utils/layerwise_offload.py:14-28` — `_USE_CHUNKWISE_IMPL = _env_bool("SGLANG_DIT_COMM_AWARE_OFFLOAD", False)` selects **at import time** between:
  - `layerwise_offload_original.py` (the SGLang "Layerwise" baseline, "old" in scripts), and
  - `layerwise_offload_chunkwise.py` (ChunkFlow, "new"/"ratio" in scripts).
- Baseline `LayerwiseOffloadManager` (`layerwise_offload_original.py:31`): at init (`:110-174`) it groups each block's params/buffers per (layer, dtype), consolidates them into **pinned CPU buffers**, and replaces GPU params with `torch.empty((1,))` placeholders (`:158`). `prefetch_layer` (`:395-455`) does one **whole-layer** async H2D `copy_` per dtype-buffer on a dedicated `copy_stream`, then records a per-layer `torch.cuda.Event` (`:439-441`). Forward pre-hooks (`:633-679`) make the compute stream `wait_event` on that layer's event, and every `prefetch_size` layers trigger prefetch of the window `[i+prefetch_size, i+2*prefetch_size)` (`:674-677`); post-hooks release the layer (`:681-693`, `release_layer:468-490`; layer 0 is kept warm). `prefetch_size` comes from `--dit-offload-prefetch-size` via `OffloadableDiTMixin.configure_layerwise_offload` (`:721-749`; fraction <1.0 → `1+round(frac*(L-1))`, ≥1 → absolute; default 0.0 → 1 layer). The baseline also has `quiesce_copy_stream_for_comm` (`:458-465`) but launches whole-layer copies, so it cannot yield mid-layer — that's the contention the paper measures.
- Enablement: `runtime/managers/gpu_worker.py:136-153` calls `dit.configure_layerwise_offload(server_args)` for every `OffloadableDiTMixin` DiT when `server_args.dit_layerwise_offload` is true.

## 2. Chunked prefetching (ChunkFlow) — `layerwise_offload_chunkwise.py`

- Manager ctor `:87-115`: `prefetch_chunk_size_bytes = max(1, prefetch_chunk_size_mb) * 1024*1024` (code default **32 MB**; the experiment scripts pin **16 MB** = the paper's C). Weights are consolidated per (layer, **phase**, dtype) into pinned CPU buffers (`_initialize:1458-1623`); phases come from per-model `PhaseSpec`s (Wan: `entry/self_attn_tail/cross_attn/ffn`, `wanvideo.py:764-799`).
- A **background prefetch thread** (`_prefetch_worker_loop:1083-1106`) picks the next (layer, phase) from a schedule (`_pick_next_phase_locked:985-1019`, urgent-layer first, then nearest-to-anchor), and before **each chunk** calls `_wait_for_comm_inactive` (`:1031-1057`) → blocks while any collective is active — this is the pauseable/resumable prefetch.
- `_copy_one_chunk` (`:1146-1305`) is the chunk engine: under `_copy_lock` it re-checks `comm_tracker.is_active()` (`:1153` and again `:1241` — the pause-flag checks at chunk boundaries), lazily allocates the phase's GPU buffer and binds weights into it (`_bind_phase_weights_locked:1108-1118`), slices the next `chunk_numel = prefetch_chunk_size_bytes // element_size` elements (`:1216-1220`), and issues `dst.copy_(src, non_blocking=False)` on the copy stream (`:1258-1262`, comment: "Intentionally blocking per chunk for strict comm-aware checkpoints"), recording a `chunk_done_event`; when a phase's offsets reach the end, a **phase-complete CUDA event** is recorded on the copy stream (`:1296-1299`), and a layer-complete event when all phases finish (`_mark_layer_complete_locked:602-610`).
- Compute-side sync: forward pre-hook (`register_forward_hooks:1920-1977`, pre-hook `:1934-1958`) schedules the prefetch window and calls `_ensure_phase_ready` (`:1360-1456`), which spins (helping copy chunks synchronously if the worker is dead) until the target phase/window event exists, then `torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_event(event)` (`:1441-1442`). Mid-block **phase barriers**: model code calls `phase_barrier_fn(block_idx, "self_attn_tail"/"cross_attn"/"ffn")` (e.g. `wanvideo.py:520,537,550`, wired at `:1291` via `_ensure_block_phase_ready:951-953` → mixin `ensure_offload_phase_ready:2164-2170` → `ensure_named_phase_ready:1901-1918`, which also evicts completed earlier phases). Post-hook releases the layer (`release_layer:1729-1767`; layer 0 kept warm, resident tensors skipped).

### How collectives raise the pause flag (`comm_aware_prefetch.py` + `usp.py` + `attention/layer.py`)

- `CommunicationActivityTracker` (`runtime/utils/comm_aware_prefetch.py:55`) holds an `_active` counter behind a condition variable — the pause flag. `is_active()` (`:232`), `wait_until_inactive()` (`:236-259`), `mark_start/mark_end` (`:221-230`).
- **Window modes** (`_normalize_window_mode:10-16`): `"launch"` = old behavior, active only during the host-side wrapper; `"kernel"` = active until GPU-side completion. In kernel mode a `_KernelCommRegion` (`:19-52`) calls `record_start()` (increments the flag) and ends either via a CUDA **end event recorded after the collective** ("kernel end marker") or, preferably, via the NCCL `Work` handle attached with `set_nccl_work` (`:34-38`). Two daemon watcher threads retire regions: `_kernel_event_loop` (`:188-219`) polls end events; `_nccl_work_wait_loop` (`:124-186`) polls **all pending NCCL Works in parallel** and decrements the flag when `work.is_completed()` — this is the "monitor work complete marker" commit (94da08ee2; the 3c98f0c33 "fix mem" made it parallel-polling + drop Work refs so the pending list stays bounded).
- Ulysses all-to-all call sites wrap every collective: `usp.py:_usp_all_to_all_single` (`:147-197`) begins a comm region, calls `_quiesce_prefetch_for_comm` (freeze new chunk launches by taking every manager's `_copy_lock`, drain in-flight H2D via `current_stream().wait_stream(copy_stream)`, then `after_drain` records region start — mixin `quiesce_prefetch_for_comm:2172-2190`), then in kernel-window mode issues `dist.all_to_all_single(..., async_op=True)` (`:178`), blocks the compute stream on the Work (`_block_work_on_current_stream:126-134`) and attaches the Work to the region (`:180`). Same pattern for the DistributedAttention path in `runtime/layers/attention/layer.py`: `_comm_aware_sequence_all_to_all_4d:123-145`, `_comm_aware_sequence_all_gather:148-166` (async impls at `:47-120`). The tracker/quiesce fn reach these sites via the forward context (`forward_context.py:44-45`), set in each DiT forward (`wanvideo.py:97-101,1145-1150`; `flux.py:91`; `hunyuanvideo.py:52`; `flux_2.py:45`). Optionally `patch_torch_distributed` (`comm_aware_prefetch.py:269-363`) monkeypatches `dist.all_to_all_single/all_reduce/...` — off by default (`SGLANG_DIT_COMM_AWARE_PATCH_TORCH_DIST=0`); explicit scopes are the normal path.

## 3. Partial residency

Two mechanisms, both driven by `resident_ratio` and quantized to **chunk multiples** (`_quantized_target_bytes:251-257` — rounds `total_chunks * ratio` to whole 16MB chunks, matching the paper's "keep a fraction of chunks resident"):

- **Tensorwise resident prefix** (default, used in experiments): when `SGLANG_DIT_OFFLOAD_RESIDENT_RATIO` is set and `SGLANG_DIT_PHASE_AWARE_PREFETCH=0`, `_build_tensorwise_resident_prefix` (`:295-320`) takes layer 0 as a template, walks tensors in order, and marks the prefix whose cumulative bytes reach `ratio × layer_bytes` (chunk-quantized) as resident. In `_initialize` (`:1529-1549`) resident tensors are **never offloaded** — they keep their original GPU storage, are excluded from CPU consolidation, phase byte counts, release (`:1743-1747`) and eviction. The same relative-name prefix is resident in every layer.
- **Phase-based residency** (phase-aware mode, `SGLANG_DIT_PHASE_AWARE_PREFETCH=1`): `--dit-offload-resident-phases entry,ffn` names coarse phases to keep resident, or the ratio picks a prefix of phases (`_derive_phase_prefix_by_ratio:259-293`); phases are auto-bucketed into chunk-size buckets (`_build_effective_bucket_phases:328-423`).

## 4. All knobs — exact names and defaults

CLI flags (`runtime/server_args.py`, fields `:296-308`, argparse `:787-860`):
- `--dit-layerwise-offload` (bool, default `None`; auto-enabled for Wan/MOVA on some platforms `:547-559`; MPS forces false `:543-545`) — master switch for BOTH baseline and ChunkFlow.
- `--dit-offload-prefetch-size` (float, default `0.0` → 1 layer; <1.0 = fraction of layers, ≥1 = absolute; validation `:1107-1121`).
- `--dit-offload-resident-phases` (csv str, default `""`).
- `--dit-offload-resident-ratio` (float in [0,1], default `None`; 0.0 → disabled).
- `--dit-offload-phase-prefetch-depth` (int, default `4`).
- `--dit-comm-active-window-mode` (`kernel`|`launch`, default `"kernel"`).
- `--pin-cpu-memory` (default `True`), `--dit-cpu-offload` (whole-model offload, mutually exclusive with layerwise `:1124-1160`), `--num-gpus` (default 1), `--ulysses-degree` (default → sp_degree; SP degree knob).

Env vars (read via `os.getenv` in `layerwise_offload*.py` / `configure_layerwise_offload:2009-2138`; env overrides the CLI value where both exist):
- `SGLANG_DIT_COMM_AWARE_OFFLOAD` (default 0) — **ChunkFlow master switch**; read at import (`layerwise_offload.py:14`) to pick the implementation AND at configure (`:2012-2015`). There is no CLI flag for it (the `getattr(server_args,"dit_comm_aware_offload")` fallback has no backing field). Must be in the process env before launch.
- `SGLANG_DIT_COMM_PREFETCH_CHUNK_SIZE_MB` (code default **32**; scripts set **16** = paper C).
- `SGLANG_DIT_COMM_ACTIVE_WINDOW_MODE` (default from flag, `kernel`).
- `SGLANG_DIT_COMM_AWARE_PATCH_TORCH_DIST` (default 0).
- `SGLANG_DIT_PHASE_AWARE_PREFETCH` (default 0).
- `SGLANG_DIT_OFFLOAD_RESIDENT_RATIO` (default unset; experiments use 0.4), `SGLANG_DIT_OFFLOAD_RESIDENT_PHASES` (csv), `SGLANG_DIT_OFFLOAD_PHASE_PREFETCH_DEPTH` (4).
- `SGLANG_DIT_OFFLOAD_PHASE_PREFETCH_RATIO` — **deprecated, ignored** (warning `:2049-2061`).
- `SGLANG_DIT_OFFLOAD_DEFER_BUCKET_RELEASE` (default 0, auto-bucket mode only), `SGLANG_OFFLOAD_EMPTY_CACHE_AFTER_INIT` (default 0).
- `SGLANG_DIT_COMM_PREFETCH_SUBMODULE_GRANULARITY` — exported by `run_access.sh` but **not read anywhere in Python** (vestigial; `submodule_granularity=True` hardcoded `:2111`).
- Mock-PCIe-comm (Wan only, `wanvideo.py:896-944`): `SGLANG_WAN_MOCK_COMM_ENABLE` (0), `_EVERY_N_BLOCKS` (1), `_DEBUG` (0), `_PCIE_MB` (64 code / 512 scripts), `_VIRTUAL_SP_DEGREE` (2 code / 4 scripts), `_TRAFFIC_SCALE` (1.0), `_MAX_MB` (256).
- Profiling: `SGLANG_DIFFUSION_SYNC_STAGE_PROFILING=1`, `SGLANG_DIFFUSION_STAGE_LOGGING=1`, `SGLANG_DIFFUSION_LOG_DENOISING_STEP_TIMES`.

## Mode recipes (exactly what the paper's scripts run, `offload_profiling/`)

All modes share: `sglang generate --model-path $MODEL_PATH --text-encoder-cpu-offload --pin-cpu-memory --num-gpus $N --ulysses-degree $N --attention-backend sage_attn --enable-torch-compile ...` (defaults `NUM_GPUS=2 ULYSSES_DEGREE=2`; for the rebuttal use `NUM_GPUS=4 ULYSSES_DEGREE=4` too):
- **No-Offload** (`run_access_no.sh`): `--dit-layerwise-offload false`, `SGLANG_DIT_COMM_AWARE_OFFLOAD=0` (image models additionally get `--dit-cpu-offload true` by default from `run_profile.sh`).
- **Layerwise baseline** ("old", `run_access_old.sh`): `--dit-layerwise-offload true --dit-offload-prefetch-size 1`, `SGLANG_DIT_COMM_AWARE_OFFLOAD=0`.
- **ChunkFlow** ("new", `run_access.sh`): same flags + `SGLANG_DIT_COMM_AWARE_OFFLOAD=1 SGLANG_DIT_COMM_ACTIVE_WINDOW_MODE=kernel SGLANG_DIT_COMM_PREFETCH_CHUNK_SIZE_MB=16 SGLANG_DIT_PHASE_AWARE_PREFETCH=0 SGLANG_DIT_OFFLOAD_RESIDENT_RATIO=` (empty).
- **ChunkFlow + partial residency** ("ratio", `run_access_phase.sh` → `run_access.sh` with `PROFILE_MODE=ratio`): adds `SGLANG_DIT_OFFLOAD_RESIDENT_RATIO=0.4` (still `SGLANG_DIT_PHASE_AWARE_PREFETCH=0` → tensorwise resident prefix).
- Orchestrator: `run_profile.sh <wanvideo|hunyuanvideo|flux|flux_2> [--steps warmup,no,old,new,ratio,analyze] [--resident-ratio r] [--comm-window-mode kernel|launch]` under `nsys profile`.

In-repo design docs: `runtime/prefetch_comm_contention_analysis.md` and `runtime/comm_aware_trace_findings.md` (per-model comm sites, FLOP/prefetch-byte models, coverage conditions).

offload_profiling/*.sh are cluster-specific (TAMU HPC): `module load Miniforge3/CUDA 12.8/GCC`, model paths under /scratch/user/u.hm347392/, repo-local .venv, and a hard nsys dependency — on this Vast box remove the module loads, set MODEL_PATH/WAN_MODEL_PATH etc., activate /venv/main, and install nsys or strip the nsys wrapper.

Blackwell sm_120 + CUDA-13 driver: default ATTENTION_BACKEND=sage_attn — sageattention (and torch) must have sm_120 kernels; per the box's CLAUDE.md use cu128+ wheels or newer, otherwise 'no kernel image' at first GPU op. Fall back to a different --attention-backend if sage_attn lacks sm_120 builds.

The paper's ratio-resident mode is the TENSORWISE prefix (SGLANG_DIT_OFFLOAD_RESIDENT_RATIO set, SGLANG_DIT_PHASE_AWARE_PREFETCH=0); setting SGLANG_DIT_PHASE_AWARE_PREFETCH=1 switches to phase-bucket residency + mid-block phase barriers — a different code path (record_stream protection, eviction), so do not mix modes when comparing.

For No-Offload on image models (flux/flux_2), run_profile.sh defaults to also passing --dit-cpu-offload true (whole-model stage offload) so it fits; that baseline is not pure 'weights always resident' unless you override PROFILE_DIT_CPU_OFFLOAD/DIT_CPU_OFFLOAD_OVERRIDE=false and have the VRAM.
SGLANG_DIT_COMM_PREFETCH_SUBMODULE_GRANULARITY (exported by run_access.sh) is read nowhere in Python — vestigial; SGLANG_DIT_OFFLOAD_PHASE_PREFETCH_RATIO is deprecated and ignored with a warning.

Whole DiT weights are staged in pinned host RAM (pin_cpu_memory=True); check host RAM before running HunyuanVideo (~25GB bf16) plus text encoders — pinned alloc failures need --pin-cpu-memory false (slower H2D).

Layerwise offload is mutually exclusive with --dit-cpu-offload, --use-fsdp-inference and cache-dit (SGLANG_CACHE_DIT_ENABLED); server_args auto-disables the first two with a warning (server_args.py:1124-1160). It is also AUTO-ENABLED for Wan/MOVA pipelines on some platforms (:547-559) — pass --dit-layerwise-offload false explicitly for the No-Offload arm.

SP degree is set by --ulysses-degree (with --num-gpus); scripts default NUM_GPUS=2 ULYSSES_DEGREE=2 — export NUM_GPUS=4 ULYSSES_DEGREE=4 for the SP-4 rebuttal runs. 4x5090 has no NVLink, so NCCL all-to-all rides PCIe and contends with H2D prefetch — the effect ChunkFlow targets should be stronger than on NVLinked H100s.

Comm-window 'kernel' mode changes the collective code path itself (async_op=True + Work.block_current_stream vs functional collectives) — comparing kernel vs launch modes also compares those two collective implementations, not just the tracking window.
Mock-communication injection (SGLANG_WAN_MOCK_COMM_*) exists only in WanTransformer3DModel, not flux/hunyuan.
Wan profiling resolution must be 1280x704 (not 720) for Wan2.2-TI2V-5B — 720 trips a scheduler shape mismatch (documented in model_profile_common.sh).

# ChunkFlow experiment harness (`/workspace/sglang/offload_profiling/`)

## 1. How the paper's experiments are launched

Everything goes through the `sglang generate` CLI (console script `sglang = "sglang.cli.main:main"`, `python/pyproject.toml:157` -> `python/sglang/cli/generate.py` -> `sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.entrypoints.cli.generate.generate_cmd`), wrapped in Nsight Systems. The canonical paper command (from `offload_profiling/run_access.sh:159-168`) is:

```bash
nsys profile --trace=cuda,nvtx,osrt --cuda-memory-usage=true \
  --trace-fork-before-exec=true --kill=none --force-overwrite=true \
  --output="$NSYS_OUTPUT_PREFIX" \
  sglang generate \
    --model-path "$MODEL_PATH" --text-encoder-cpu-offload --pin-cpu-memory \
    --dit-layerwise-offload true --dit-offload-prefetch-size 1 \
    --num-gpus "$NUM_GPUS" --ulysses-degree "$ULYSSES_DEGREE" \
    --attention-backend "$ATTENTION_BACKEND" \
    --prompt "$PROMPT" --num-outputs-per-prompt "$NUM_OUTPUTS_PER_PROMPT" \
    --num-frames "$NUM_FRAMES" --height "$HEIGHT" --width "$WIDTH" \
    --num-inference-steps "$NUM_INFERENCE_STEPS" \
    --guidance-scale "$GUIDANCE_SCALE" [--guidance-scale-2 "$GUIDANCE_SCALE_2"] \
    [--enable-torch-compile] \
    --perf-dump-path "$PERF_OUT" \
    --output-path "$OUTPUT_DIR" --output-file-name "$OUTPUT_FILE_NAME" [--no-save-output]
```

Shared defaults come from `offload_profiling/model_profile_common.sh`:
- Prompt: `"A cat walks on the grass, realistic"` (lines 79, 110). `NUM_GPUS=2`, `ULYSSES_DEGREE=2`, `ATTENTION_BACKEND=sage_attn`, batch 1 (lines 111-114).
- Model resolution (`resolve_profile_model`, lines 25-107) - hardcoded TAMU-cluster paths with env overrides:
  - `wanvideo`: `WANVIDEO_MODEL_PATH` or `/scratch/user/u.hm347392/model{,s}/Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-Diffusers` (lines 35-41)
  - `flux`: `FLUX_MODEL_PATH` or `.../FLUX.1-dev` (43-49); `flux_2`: `FLUX_2_MODEL_PATH` or `.../FLUX.2-klein-4B` (51-57); `hunyuanvideo`: `HUNYUANVIDEO_MODEL_PATH` or `.../HunyuanVideo` (59-65). `MODEL_PATH` overrides all and may be an HF repo id (the standalone `run.sh:42` defaults to `Wan-AI/Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-Diffusers`). Registry-known HF ids: `Wan-AI/Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-Diffusers` (`python/sglang/multimodal_gen/registry.py:529`), `hunyuanvideo-community/HunyuanVideo` (:454), `black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-dev` (:577), `black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-4B` (:585).
- Per-model shapes (`apply_profile_model_defaults`, lines 121-151):
  - wanvideo: `NUM_FRAMES=81`, `HEIGHT=704`, `WIDTH=1280` (704 not 720 - patchify comment at 132-137), `NUM_INFERENCE_STEPS=10`, `GUIDANCE_SCALE=4.0`, `GUIDANCE_SCALE_2=3.0`
  - hunyuanvideo: 81 frames, 720x1280, 10 steps, gs 1.0
  - flux/flux_2: 1 frame, 1024x1024, 10 steps, gs 1.0 (and `SGLANG_FORCE_DIFFUSERS_TIMESTEP_EMBEDDING=1`, `run_access.sh:52-54`)
- Outputs land in `offload_profiling/results/<model>/` (media) and `offload_profiling/results/profiles/<model>/` (`*_nsys.nsys-rep`, `perf_*_profiled.json`) via `apply_profile_output_layout` (lines 154-171).

The full paper matrix is driven by `offload_profiling/run_profile.sh` (`bash offload_profiling/run_profile.sh <model> [num_frames]` or `--model ... --batch-size ... --resident-ratio ... --steps warmup,no,old,new,ratio,analyze`): warmup dry-run (no-offload, `DRY_RUN=1` via `run_access_no.sh`, separate ports `WARMUP_SERVER_PORT=30100`/`WARMUP_SCHEDULER_PORT=5748`/`WARMUP_MASTER_PORT=30170`, lines 103-105, 245-268), then for video models new -> ratio -> no -> old (lines 300-322; image models run no -> old -> new -> ratio, 270-299), then `analyze_nsys.sh` (323-325). `run_profile_dmon.sh` wraps `run_profile.sh` with background `nvidia-smi dmon` + `nvidia-smi --query-gpu` telemetry and `analyze_clock_drop.py` per-stage summary (lines 159-291).

## 2. What each run*.sh variant does

Two generations of scripts:

**Standalone Wan-only mock-comm trio (older, 1 GPU + emulated comm):** `run.sh`, `run_no.sh`, `run_old.sh`. Defaults `NUM_GPUS=1`, `ULYSSES_DEGREE=1`, `NUM_INFERENCE_STEPS=9`, gs `3.5/4.0`, HF-id model path, `--enable-torch-compile` unconditionally (the guard is commented out, `run.sh:76-78`), and **mock communication enabled** (`SGLANG_WAN_MOCK_COMM_ENABLE=1` default) which fakes Ulysses all-to-all with PCIe D2H/H2D copies sized for a virtual SP degree (`SGLANG_WAN_MOCK_COMM_VIRTUAL_SP_DEGREE=4`), implemented in `python/sglang/multimodal_gen/runtime/models/dits/wanvideo.py:896-946`.
- `run.sh`: ChunkFlow ("new"): `--dit-layerwise-offload true`, `SGLANG_DIT_COMM_AWARE_OFFLOAD=1`, `SGLANG_DIT_PHASE_AWARE_PREFETCH=1`, chunk 16 MB (lines 86-99).

## 3. Architecture (how ChunkFlow is wired)
- `utils/layerwise_offload.py` is now a **runtime dispatcher**: env `SGLANG_DIT_COMM_AWARE_OFFLOAD=1` selects `layerwise_offload_chunkwise.py` (2,270 lines, "new"); otherwise `layerwise_offload_original.py` (859 lines, preserved as the "old" baseline).

Per-step CUDA-event stats (copy bytes, wait-comm time, exposed waits) are exported through `gpu_worker._collect_offload_profile_metrics()` into the perf JSON `extra.offload_profile`.
- `comm_aware_prefetch.py`: `CommunicationActivityTracker` with two window modes — **"launch"** (active only during the host-side collective wrapper; the original paper-era behavior) and **"kernel"** (default at HEAD; `begin_kernel_region()` + NCCL-work wait loop + kernel event loop keep H2D paused until the collective's stream-level completion). - Comm entry points: `layers/usp.py` (USP all-to-all — Wan, Flux; NVTX `SGL_REAL_COMM_USP_DEV{n}`, device-index parameterized, not hard-coded to 2 ranks) and `layers/attention/layer.py` (`UlyssesAttention` — HunyuanVideo).
- Models: `wanvideo.py` (+359 lines: `BLOCK_PHASE_SPECS` = entry / self_attn_tail / cross_attn / ffn, plus a **mock-comm subsystem** `SGLANG_WAN_MOCK_COMM_*` that injects synthetic PCIe D2H round-trips to emulate a *virtual SP degree* — directly relevant for emulating comm pressure), `flux.py`, `flux_2.py`, `hunyuanvideo.py` similarly instrumented.
- `stages/denoising.py`: NVTX `SGL_DENOISING_LOOP` / `SGL_DENOISING_STEP_{i}` ranges + per-step offload-profile index (analysis uses steady-state steps 1–9).
- New server args: `--dit-offload-resident-phases`, `--dit-offload-resident-ratio`, `--dit-offload-phase-prefetch-depth` (default 4 = Wan phase count), `--dit-comm-active-window-mode` (default "kernel"). Env vars override all of them.

## 4. Finished vs in-progress
**Finished/stable:** chunked comm-aware prefetch in launch-window mode; old/new/no/ratio profiling matrix across 4 models; chunk-granularity resident ratio; nsys + perf-JSON analysis pipeline; dry-run warmup; dmon monitoring.

**In progress at HEAD (critical for rebuttal):** the **kernel-window comm mode**. `comm_aware_trace_findings.md` (§5–6) documents that the launch-window "new" path still had **massive real H2D/NCCL overlap** (e.g. Flux bs=8: ~62% of NCCL time overlapped, ~276 ms/rank/step NCCL inflation) because `mark_end` fired at kernel *launch*, ~200–1000 ms before the NCCL kernel actually ran. The **first** kernel-window attempt was *slower* (Flux bs=8: 2.011 vs 1.895 s/step — start too early, end still on the wrong stream; §6.6). **Head-count divisibility for degree 4**
- The Ulysses all-to-all asserts `h % world_size == 0` (`runtime/layers/usp.py:233-235`) and `s % world_size == 0` on the output a2a (`usp.py:291-293`). Sequence length is padded to a multiple of `sp_size` in the Wan model (`runtime/models/dits/wanvideo.py:1206-1221`), so only heads matter.

Box confirmed: 4x RTX 5090 (cc 12.0), driver 580.159.03 (CUDA 13), system nvcc 13.0, all GPUs "NODE" topology (PCIe via host bridge, **no NVLink, no P2P** — GeForce).

**Attention backend selection** (`runtime/platforms/cuda.py:151-379`, enum in `runtime/platforms/interface.py:26-53`)

On sm_120: explicit `--attention-backend fa` falls back to **Torch SDPA** (`cuda.py:296-300`); default/no-backend also falls back to Torch SDPA (`cuda.py:313-317`).
